title: 争议矿批暂定验收：取样复检、付款控制与押运放行
english: Provisional acceptance of a disputed mineral lot

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 重音练习：provisional / reconciliation / segregation；每条慢读三遍。
lines: Provisional acceptance
暂定验收
Segregated inventory
隔离存货
Independent umpire laboratory
独立仲裁实验室
Moisture adjustment
水分调整
Reconciliation statement
对账说明
Documentary evidence
书面证据

modules.title: 十个高频词组
modules.hint: 遮住中文解释英文，再遮住英文口述。
lines: Provisional invoice
暂定发票
Final settlement
最终结算
Retained sample
留存样
Sampling protocol
取样规程
Assay tolerance
化验允许偏差
Moisture deduction
水分扣减
Beneficiary verification
收款人核验
Four-eyes approval
双人复核审批
Seal register
封签登记簿
Document release checklist
单证放行检查表

modules.title: 十个核心句
modules.hint: 每句慢读两次、正常读两次，最后脱稿复述。
lines: We can acknowledge receipt without accepting the final grade.
我们可以确认收货，但不代表接受最终品位。
Please keep the disputed bags in a clearly marked area.
请把有争议的矿袋存放在标识清楚的区域。
Both parties should witness the sampling procedure.
双方应共同见证取样程序。
The retained sample must remain sealed until the dispute is resolved.
留存样必须保持封存直至争议解决。
The provisional invoice is not a final settlement statement.
暂定发票不是最终结算单。
Please explain the moisture adjustment line by line.
请逐项解释水分调整。
We cannot redirect payment based on a messaging-app instruction.
我们不能仅凭聊天软件指示更改付款去向。
The bank account must pass independent verification.
银行账户必须通过独立核验。
The escort team must record the seal before departure.
押运队必须在出发前登记封签。
Release will follow the approved document checklist.
放行须遵循已批准的单证检查表。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 以下全部为教学假设，先心算后朗读，注意吨与公斤、百分比与百分点的区别。
lines: The hypothetical lot weighs twelve point six metric tonnes.
假设该批货物重12.6公吨。
The preliminary grade is twenty-eight point four percent.
初步品位为28.4%。
The second assay reads twenty-seven point nine percent.
第二次化验品位为27.9%。
The difference is zero point five percentage points, not zero point five percent.
差异是0.5个百分点，而不是0.5%。
The exercise price is one hundred and eighty US dollars per tonne-unit.
练习价格为每吨度180美元。
At twenty-eight point four units, the illustrative gross price is five thousand one hundred and twelve dollars per tonne.
按28.4度计算，示例每吨毛价为5,112美元。
At an assumed exchange rate of one thousand four hundred and eighty francs per dollar, one thousand dollars equals one million four hundred and eighty thousand francs.
按假设汇率1美元兑1,480法郎，1,000美元等于148万法郎。
Please read back the weight, grade, unit price and currency before approval.
审批前请复述重量、品位、吨度价格和币种。

modules.title: 影子跟读
modules.hint: 先听完整对话，再延迟半秒跟读，三轮分别为慢速、正常、脱稿。
lines: Buyer: We received the lot, but the assay discrepancy remains open.
买方：我们已收到这批货，但化验差异仍未解决。
Supplier: Can you release the provisional amount today?
供应商：你们今天能支付暂定金额吗？
Buyer: Only after the quantity is reconciled and the beneficiary is verified.
买方：只有在数量核对和收款人核验完成后才可以。
Supplier: Will the retained sample be sent to a third-party lab?
供应商：留存样会送第三方实验室吗？
Buyer: Yes, under a jointly signed chain-of-custody form.
买方：会的，并使用双方签署的样品交接记录。
Supplier: When can we expect the final statement?
供应商：何时能收到最终结算单？
Buyer: We will provide a written timeline after the laboratory confirms receipt.
买方：实验室确认收样后，我们将提供书面时间表。

modules.title: 商务寒暄
modules.hint: 保持礼貌但不承诺未经授权的付款。
lines: How was the journey from the collection site?
从收购点过来一路顺利吗？
I hope your team had a safe trip.
希望你们团队一路平安。
Would you like some water before we review the documents?
核对文件前要喝点水吗？
Thank you for bringing the original weighing records.
感谢你带来原始称重记录。
We appreciate the long-term relationship and want a transparent resolution.
我们重视长期合作，希望透明解决问题。
Shall we agree on today's agenda before discussing the numbers?
讨论数字前，我们先确认今天的议程好吗？

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 模拟采购、仓库、实验室三方会议，练习追问与复述。
lines: Procurement: Which bags were included in the composite sample?
采购：混合样包含哪些矿袋？
Warehouse: Bags one through twelve were weighed separately.
仓库：1至12号矿袋分别称重。
Lab: Was the sampling equipment cleaned between lots?
实验室：不同批次之间取样设备清洁了吗？
Procurement: Please show the sampling log and the witness signatures.
采购：请出示取样日志和见证签名。
Supplier: Our assay result is higher than yours.
供应商：我们的化验结果比你们高。
Procurement: Let us compare methods, moisture basis and sample identifiers first.
采购：先比较检测方法、水分基准和样品编号。
Lab: We recommend testing the sealed retained sample at an agreed independent laboratory.
实验室：建议将封存留存样送至双方认可的独立实验室。
Procurement: Record any objection in the minutes without changing the original data.
采购：将异议记入会议纪要，不修改原始数据。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 用口头交接复核封签、路线、文件。
lines: Dispatcher: Please read the container number aloud.
调度：请大声读出集装箱编号。
Escort: The seal is intact and its number matches the register.
押运：封签完好，号码与登记簿一致。
Dispatcher: Do you have the packing list and transport permit?
调度：你有装箱单和运输许可证吗？
Escort: The customs declaration is still awaiting confirmation.
押运：海关申报仍待确认。
Dispatcher: Do not represent the shipment as cleared before clearance is confirmed.
调度：清关确认前不得声称货物已清关。
Escort: I will report any route change and obtain the required approval.
押运：路线变化时我会报告并取得必要批准。

modules.title: 十五分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三个决策点各五分钟：第一分钟听压力，第二分钟口答，第三分钟追问，第四分钟示范，第五分钟脱稿。
lines: Decision one — Supplier: Accept our higher grade now, or we will stop deliveries.
决策一——供应商：现在接受我们的较高品位，否则停止供货。
Response: We value your supply, but the final grade must follow the agreed independent test. We can document a provisional position without changing the original assays.
示范：我们重视供货，但最终品位必须依据约定的独立检测。我们可以记录暂定立场，但不会修改原始化验结果。
Follow-up: What if the laboratory takes another week?
追问：如果实验室还需要一周怎么办？
Response: We will agree on a written timetable and keep the disputed quantity segregated in the meantime.
示范：我们会约定书面时间表，并在此期间隔离存放争议数量。
Decision two — Manager: Pay the new bank account immediately; I will approve it later.
决策二——经理：立即向新银行账户付款，我稍后补批。
Response: I cannot bypass beneficiary verification or dual approval. I will escalate the urgent request and arrange an independent callback using verified contact details.
示范：我不能绕过收款人核验或双人审批。我会升级紧急申请，并使用已核实联系方式独立回拨确认。
Follow-up: Are you refusing a direct instruction?
追问：你是在拒绝直接指示吗？
Response: I am protecting the company and the supplier by following the approved payment controls.
示范：我是在遵守已批准的付款控制，以保护公司和供应商。
Decision three — Forwarder: The truck is ready. Sign the export checklist even though the seal number differs.
决策三——货代：卡车已准备好。虽然封签号不一致，你先签出口检查表。
Response: We must hold release, photograph the seal, compare the source records and obtain written clearance after the discrepancy is resolved.
示范：我们必须暂停放行，拍摄封签，对照原始记录，并在差异解决后取得书面放行批准。
Follow-up: The driver says the border will close soon.
追问：司机说边境马上关闭。
Response: A deadline does not authorize a false record. I will notify logistics and request a revised departure slot.
示范：截止时间不能成为虚假记录的理由。我会通知物流并申请调整发车时段。

modules.title: 五句听写
modules.hint: 每句先隐藏英文听读，再写出英文，对照纠错；本模块不提供外部音频。
lines: The disputed stock remains under controlled storage.
争议库存仍处于受控仓储状态。
Please verify the account through a separate channel.
请通过独立渠道核验账户。
We need a signed sample transfer record.
我们需要签署的样品移交记录。
The provisional amount is subject to adjustment.
暂定金额可能调整。
No truck may leave without release authorization.
未经放行授权，任何卡车不得离开。

modules.title: 五道口语题
modules.hint: 每题限时30秒，先独立回答再用示范答案修正。
lines: Question: How would you explain an assay disagreement? Answer: I would compare the sampling method, sample ID and testing basis before proposing an independent retest.
问题：如何解释化验分歧？示范：我会先比较取样方法、样品编号和检测基准，再建议独立复检。
Question: Can you pay against an unverified account? Answer: No. I must verify the beneficiary independently and obtain the required approvals.
问题：能向未核实账户付款吗？示范：不能，必须独立核实收款人并取得必要审批。
Question: What should an escort do with a broken seal? Answer: Stop, preserve evidence, notify the responsible team and await written instructions.
问题：押运人员发现封签破损怎么办？示范：停车、保全证据、通知责任团队并等待书面指示。
Question: What is a provisional invoice? Answer: It records an interim amount that may change after final verification.
问题：什么是暂定发票？示范：它记录核验完成后可能调整的临时金额。
Question: How do you keep a difficult meeting constructive? Answer: I acknowledge concerns, summarize verified facts and agree on documented next steps.
问题：如何让困难会议保持建设性？示范：我认可对方关切、总结已核实事实并约定书面后续步骤。

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.hint: 复习近期三课：单证、三方对账、取样复检；先遮住英文再说。
lines: A batch-number mismatch requires a documented reconciliation.
批次号不符需要形成书面对账记录。
A three-party reconciliation must distinguish confirmed and disputed balances.
三方对账必须区分已确认余额和争议余额。
An independent retest must preserve sample traceability.
独立复检必须保留样品可追溯性。
An urgent deadline never justifies backdating an export document.
紧急截止时间绝不能成为倒签出口文件的理由。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 连读两遍，第二遍不看英文，控制在约一分钟。
lines: Good morning. Today we received a hypothetical mineral lot with a difference between the preliminary and secondary assay results.
早上好。今天我们收到一批教学假设矿货，初检与复检结果存在差异。
The warehouse has segregated the disputed bags and preserved the original weighing and sampling records.
仓库已隔离争议矿袋，并保留原始称重和取样记录。
We propose a jointly witnessed transfer of the retained sample to an independent laboratory.
我们建议双方共同见证，将留存样移交独立实验室。
Any provisional payment will depend on reconciled quantity, verified beneficiary details and approved controls.
任何暂定付款都以数量核对、收款人信息核验及审批控制为前提。
Logistics will check the seal register and export documents before authorizing dispatch.
物流部门将在授权发车前检查封签登记簿和出口文件。
I will circulate the meeting minutes, responsible owners and next review date after this meeting.
会后我会分发会议纪要、责任人及下次复核日期。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 完成后勾选，未完成的模块次日优先复习。
lines: I pronounced all six warm-up expressions clearly.
我已清晰朗读六个发音热身词组。
I recalled ten phrases and ten core sentences without looking.
我已脱稿回忆十个词组和十个核心句。
I read the illustrative quantities, grades and exchange rate correctly.
我已正确读出示例重量、品位和汇率。
I completed all three five-minute pressure decisions.
我已完成三个五分钟高压决策。
I checked five dictations and answered five speaking questions.
我已核对五句听写并回答五道口语题。
I delivered the final workplace briefing aloud.
我已口头完成最后的工作陈述。
